title: Whistleblower saw a Tic Tac offloaded from a ship
summary: Steven Greer tells of Whistleblower saw a Tic Tac offloaded from a ship, about 1991 at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and we have a whistleblower who saw it being offloaded out of a a big ship uh out of the uh in 1991, I believe.

plain: Steven Greer, an activist who campaigns for the release of UFO secrets, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a whistleblower, someone who quietly came forward from inside. Greer says this person saw a Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint, being unloaded from a big ship, in 1991 as far as Greer remembers. If true, it would mean such an object was physically in someone's hands decades ago.
